headline: We reviewed the new Pixel lineup, ask us anything
summary: Embargo lifted on Google's Pixel 11 series and Pixel Watch 5 reviews. Four comprehensive reviews are now live on the site. Subscribers have a chance to engage in an AMA session.

headline: The Pixel 11 Pro is a great phone, no thanks to its flashiest new features
summary: Google markets the Pixel 11 Pro as a device to reduce screen time. New features include proactive reservations and faster voice-to-text. The phone's core strengths outweigh its flashy, often underutilized, additions.

headline: Google’s Pixel 11 Pro Fold feels like the end of an era
summary: The foldable phone market is rapidly evolving with thinner, lighter designs. Google's Pixel 11 Pro Fold fails to keep pace with these innovations. It feels outdated compared to recent competitor models like Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold.

headline: Google’s Pixel Watch 5 is promising — but it isn’t finished
summary: The Pixel Watch 5 features minimal hardware changes, focusing primarily on software updates. It offers a slight boost in chip/battery and a new case finish. The device shows potential but is considered incomplete due to its software-centric evolution.

headline: Google Pixel 11 Pro Review
summary: The Pixel 11 Pro is deemed a good phone overall. It doesn't offer groundbreaking performance or revolutionary new features. Despite this, it remains a solid and dependable device.

headline: ‘You Don’t Get XP, But Zones Do’ — How Control Resonant Is Rewriting the Action RPG Rule Book
summary: Control Resonant introduces a unique RPG system where zones, not players, gain XP. Defeating monsters in Manhattan has lasting consequences on the game world. This title redefines action RPG progression and boss design.

headline: Subnautica 2 Early Access 1.2 Update Out Now Alongside Patch Notes, Dev Donates $100,000 to Ocean Cleanup
summary: Subnautica 2's Early Access 1.2 update is now live, introducing the 'Buddy System'. Full patch notes are available for the underwater survival game. The developer donated $100,000 to support ocean cleanup initiatives.

headline: How Marvel’s Relaunched Avengers Series Redefines Earth’s Mightiest Heroes
summary: Marvel is relaunching its flagship Avengers comic series in 2026. The reboot aims to redefine what it means to be an Avenger. Exclusive previews and interviews offer a look at the team's new direction.

headline: Track defect found on approach to site of Lewes derailment, initial report says
summary: An initial RAIB investigation revealed an 'irregularity' on the track. The defect was found on the approach to the Lewes derailment site. Findings suggest a potential cause for the incident.

headline: Thunderstorm warnings issued for parts of UK with flash flooding expected
summary: Thunderstorm warnings have been issued across several parts of the UK. Flash flooding is expected in northern England, eastern Scotland, and Northern Ireland. The warnings are set to take effect later on Wednesday.

headline: Israel confirms soldiers fired at car in which Hind Rajab was killed and opens criminal investigation
summary: Israel confirms its soldiers fired at the car carrying five-year-old Hind Rajab. A criminal investigation into the incident has been launched. Hind Rajab and six relatives were found dead after the attack.

headline: Salmonella outbreak: What we know so far
summary: Hundreds of people have been sickened by a salmonella outbreak. The infections are linked to contaminated imported eggs. Authorities are investigating the full scope and source of the outbreak.
